title: ACEF v1.1 Payload Variant Registry (additions)
description: Additive variant entries for ACEF Core v1.1. Resolved as a UNION with v1.0's variant-registry.json by acef.schemas.registry.load_variant_registry('v1.1') — v1.1 adds artifact names without removing v1.0 entries (per VAL-VARIANT-002 and the v1.x-minor freeze rule in Spec §3.1.4). The five entries here correspond to the agent-reliability primitives that F-M1-VARIANTS introduces. Of these, `verification_badge` and `evidence_freshness_window` are accompanied by oneOf payload-shape enforcement on their parent record-type schemas (transparency_disclosure, evidence_gap) in this same v1.1 directory, satisfying VAL-VARIANT-004's 'at least 2' threshold. Full oneOf enforcement for the remaining three (`human_oversight_kill_switch`, `regression_definition`, `external_disposition`) is deferred to a follow-up feature. `external_disposition` is registered against `event_log` (with /payload/event_type discriminator) because no standalone `disposition_record` schema exists in v1.1 at the time of registration; this preserves referential integrity while a dedicated record type is designed.
